extraRecovery.description: This institution interrupts the first console load of each session with a scheduled-maintenance notice that must be acknowledged before the search screen appears. It is informational only.

target.description: Acknowledge button on the system notice

notes: Cascade runs the same Meridian Core build as Northpoint, deployed with different frame names and slightly different field wording, plus a login-time notice. Three differences needed an explicit override; one did not — the accounts table labels the savings row 'Regular Savings', and the base artifact's non-exact label matching absorbs that without any entry here. That asymmetry is the point of the overlay: it carries only what fuzzy matching legitimately cannot. stepOverrides are keyed by step id, which couples an overlay to a particular recording: the hand-authored capability names its steps enter_member_id and submit_search, while the discovered one generates type_4 and click_5. Both are listed so this overlay covers both capabilities. That coupling is a real limitation of the format rather than a quirk of this file — re-recording a capability silently orphans its overrides, and the only reason the shipped artifact still worked was that both tenants happen to share a form field name, so the structural tier caught it.
